claim: Highlights the exact words you choose in captions.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; change the sample pair and assert the rendered highlight changes to the new exact word.

claim: Press R to replay the current caption from the chosen lead-in.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; select caption two, press R, and assert the visible playback position moves to its 0.8 second lead-in.

claim: Imports local VTT and SRT caption files.
sandbox: Fresh demo context; import in-memory VTT and SRT fixtures and assert parsed caption output for each.

claim: Labels uncertainty written into the caption source.
sandbox: Fresh demo sample; select the source-marked cue and assert its visible uncertainty label.

claim: Labels unusually tight or overlapping caption timing.
sandbox: Fresh demo sample; select a compressed cue, assert the timing label, disable it, and assert removal.

claim: Demo changes never alter real license or extension data.
sandbox: Fresh demo context with a real-data sentinel; change and reset the demo, leave it, and assert the sentinel is unchanged and the demo namespace is cleared.

claim: The sample and free caption tools need no account.
sandbox: Fresh demo context with no credentials; replay a caption and assert no sign-in field or external API request occurs.

claim: The website has no advertising trackers or third-party analytics.
sandbox: Fresh context; visit every public route while recording requests and assert every request remains same-origin.

claim: The loaded sample remains available during an offline reload.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context; load and control the demo, set the context offline, reload, and assert populated output and the offline notice.

claim: The download is a Manifest V3 Chrome extension package.
sandbox: Production preview; download the ZIP, verify ZIP bytes, extract its manifest, and assert Manifest V3 and product name.

claim: The extension reads a caption track exposed by an HTML5 video.
sandbox: Fresh unpacked extension in Chromium; expose an HTML5 TextTrack and assert the live overlay uses its cue.

claim: Word-pair and display settings use browser-local extension storage.
sandbox: Fresh unpacked extension; change a word pair and read the resulting extension-local storage value.

claim: The extension requests no browsing-history, microphone, camera, audio-capture, or video-capture permission.
sandbox: Fresh production artifact; inspect the manifest loaded by Chromium and assert each excluded permission is absent.

claim: The extension does not generate captions when a page has no exposed track.
sandbox: Fresh unpacked extension on an HTML5 video with no track; assert it asks for a VTT or SRT file and does not create output.

claim: Caption text is not sent off the device.
sandbox: Fresh unpacked extension; load and render a caption while recording requests, then assert there is no non-local HTTP request.

claim: Import, word highlights, timing labels, replay, and settings work without a license.
sandbox: Fresh demo context with no license; assert each core control is enabled and available.

claim: The $12 one-time supporter purchase adds optional caption appearances through Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: Request the registered product checkout, follow its Dodo redirect, and assert the product, $12 price, and one-time description.

claim: License verification sends only the token to Sociobot and reuses its verdict for one day.
sandbox: Fresh site context with an intercepted verification response; assert the request shape and no second request after reload.
